archetypes.name: dyn-final-summary-contract
archetypes.rationale: Changed prompt contracts coordinate shared policy with multiple callsite bindings.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the final-summary emit contract and all updated callsite bindings. Check that /design keeps notification stdout, Read fallback, and sidecar behavior, while /implement uses captured foreground wrapper stdout with no fallback or sidecar. Verify the harness pins would catch missing bindings without over-pinning duplicate algorithm prose. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
